name: nGZSceneGraph::cDynamicGeometryRect::cDynamicGeometryRect
notes: Lane QR, class and tests (115 mutants, 114 killed, 1 equivalent: the vertex 1 y advance moved after its texture writes): Rect_Construct. Constructor, built inline at three sites (0x377920, 0xaa0eb0, 0xaa8810: new 0xb0 then this); hooked, so those sites build ours. Sets the fields, then builds the vertex format (BeginFormat, AddElement position and texcoord, EndFormat) and asks the stride and the two offsets; +0x3c and +0x6a are not written (not compared).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cDynamicGeometryRect::Render
notes: Lane QR, class and tests (115 mutants, 114 killed, 1 equivalent: the vertex 1 y advance moved after its texture writes): Rect_Render. Slot 8, Render: re-fetches the declaration when missing or not created, reserves and locks the dynamic arrays (flag picks the A or B pair), writes nx*ny quads (positions, texture coordinates as the UV flag selects, the 16-bit index words) and draws. Float order as the original; truncations by cvttss2si. ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced: the index base is i*nx+j while the vertices are written in i*ny+j order.
